'''Herbrand''' is a surname. Notable people with the surname include:

* [[Freddy Herbrand]] (born 1944), Belgian decathlete
* [[Jacques Herbrand]] (1908–1931), French mathematician
* [[Markus Herbrand]] (born 1971), German politician
